no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Gomekli was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a drug in the intended population and outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for GOMEKLI (NDA219389). The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise unexpected safety or efficacy issues, outside expertise was not necessary, and there were no controversial issues warranting committee discussion. Only the approval letter and label were available in paperclip; no FDA review documents (SumR, CDTL, MedR, etc.) were present. There are therefore no AdComm concern-to-change linkages.
